auth.method: OAuth 2.0 account connection; Provider connection fields

operations.description: Finds busy periods across calendars in a time range.
operations.name: Find Busy/Free Periods in Calendar

operations.description: Computes open time slots shared across one or more calendars within a window, by inverting their busy blocks.

inputs.description: The calendars whose schedules must all be free. A slot is returned only when it is open on every selected calendar.
inputs.label: Calendars
inputs.name: calendar_ids

inputs.description: Start of the search window, as an absolute ISO 8601 timestamp (e.g. "2026-06-01T09:00:00Z"). Prefer absolute times over relative ones.
inputs.label: Window Start
inputs.name: start_date

inputs.description: End of the search window, as an absolute ISO 8601 timestamp (e.g. "2026-06-05T18:00:00Z").
inputs.label: Window End
inputs.name: end_date

inputs.description: Discard any open slot shorter than this many minutes. Leave empty to return every open slot regardless of length.
inputs.label: Minimum Slot Duration (minutes)
inputs.name: min_duration_minutes

inputs.description: If set together with Working Hours End, each day's open slots are clipped to this hour range, interpreted in UTC (not the calendar's local time zone). Example: 9 for 09:00 UTC. Leave both unset to return slots across the full window.
inputs.label: Working Hours Start (hour 0-23)
inputs.name: working_hours_start

inputs.description: Upper bound of the daily working-hours window. Example: 17 for 5 PM. Ignored unless Working Hours Start is also set.
inputs.label: Working Hours End (hour 0-23)
inputs.name: working_hours_end

operations.name: Find Free Time Slots

operations.description: Fetch the full details of a single Google Calendar event by its event ID.
operations.name: Get Event

operations.description: Fetch event details by its unique ID from Google Calendar.
operations.name: Get Event by ID

operations.description: Lists events in a calendar, with optional filters.
operations.name: Get Events

operations.description: Lists the individual occurrences of one recurring event series, each with its own instance event ID.

inputs.description: The event ID of the recurring SERIES (the parent), e.g. "abc123def456". Obtain it from Search Events Across Calendars or Get all Events. Individual instance IDs will not work here.
inputs.label: Recurring Event ID
inputs.name: event_id

inputs.description: Optional lower bound (inclusive) for an instance's end time, as an ISO 8601 timestamp with offset (e.g. "2026-06-01T00:00:00Z").
inputs.label: Start Time
inputs.name: time_min

inputs.description: Optional upper bound (exclusive) for an instance's start time, as an ISO 8601 timestamp with offset (e.g. "2026-06-30T23:59:59Z").
inputs.label: End Time
inputs.name: time_max

inputs.description: Whether to include cancelled (deleted) instances of the series in the result. Defaults to false.
inputs.label: Include Cancelled Instances
inputs.name: show_deleted

inputs.description: Maximum number of instances to return per page (1-2500). Defaults to the API default of 250.
inputs.label: Max Results
inputs.name: max_results

operations.name: List Recurring Event Instances

operations.description: Moves an existing event from one calendar to another, preserving its event ID and metadata.

inputs.description: The ID of the event to move, e.g. "abc123def456". Obtain it from Search Events Across Calendars or Get all Events.
inputs.label: Event ID
inputs.name: event_id

inputs.description: The calendar to move the event to.
inputs.label: Destination Calendar
inputs.name: destination_calendar_id

inputs.description: Who should receive notifications about the change of the event's organizer.
inputs.label: Send Notifications
inputs.name: send_updates

operations.name: Move Event to Another Calendar

operations.description: Searches every calendar the account can access for events matching a keyword within a required time window.

inputs.description: Free-text query matched against event fields (summary, description, location, attendee names/emails) using Google's native search. Example: "budget review".
inputs.label: Search Term
inputs.name: query

inputs.description: Lower bound (inclusive) for an event's end time, as an ISO 8601 timestamp (e.g. "2026-06-01T00:00:00Z"). Required to bound the cross-calendar scan.
inputs.label: Start Time
inputs.name: start_date

inputs.description: Upper bound (exclusive) for an event's start time, as an ISO 8601 timestamp (e.g. "2026-06-30T23:59:59Z"). Required to bound the cross-calendar scan.
inputs.label: End Time
inputs.name: end_date

inputs.description: When enabled, recurring events are expanded into their individual instances instead of returning the underlying recurring event.
inputs.label: Expand Recurring Events?
inputs.name: single_events

operations.name: Search Events Across Calendars

operations.description: Fires when an event is canceled or deleted.

inputs.description: Watch one event instead of the whole calendar.
inputs.label: Target Specific Event
inputs.name: specific_event

inputs.description: Leave empty to fire on every cancellation. Each cancellation has one reason, checked in this order: Rescheduled (title or description says "rescheduled"), Attendee Declined, Event Deleted (you organize it, or only its id is left), Other (someone else cancelled a meeting you were invited to).
inputs.label: Cancellation Reasons
inputs.name: cancellation_reason

operations.name: Event Cancelled

inputs.description: Watch one event instead of the whole calendar.
inputs.label: Target Specific Event
inputs.name: specific_event

operations.description: Triggers when an event is added or updated

inputs.description: Fires once per occurrence of a recurring event.
inputs.label: Expand Recurring Events
inputs.name: expandRecurringEvent

operations.name: New or Updated Event
